title: Smoky Syrian Chicken Pilaf
description: A flavorful Chinese-inspired dish featuring smoky Syrian chicken and a nutty pilaf.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
2. Add 1 teaspoon of smoky Syrian spice blend to the pan and toast for 1 minute.
3. Add the chicken breast to the pan and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
4. Add the pilaf rice to the pan and stir to combine with the chicken and spice blend.
5. Add 2 cups of water to the pan and bring to a boil.
6. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.
7. Stir in frozen peas and cook until thawed.
8. Season with dramatic dash of soy sauce to taste.
9. Serve hot, garnished with additional smoky Syrian spice blend if desired.
